---
title: "Deprecated By Mtime"
description: "A doc NOT draft, NOT unlisted, with deprecated: true (boolean), used to check that it resolves to the modification date of the file and acts as already deprecated."
deprecated: true
---
The content of a doc with `deprecated: true` (boolean). It has to resolve to
the modification date of the file (always in the past regarding "now"), and
therefore act as already deprecated.
